Name: PrecisionWheel
Author: DespairScent
Description:
This mod makes it possible to move items between the player's inventory and storage using the mouse wheel.

Additional features:
* By holding [b]Shift[/b], you can move 10 items at a time.
* By holding [b]Ctrl+Shift[/b], you can move 100 items at a time

This mod can be configured via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].

[url=https://github.com/DespairScent/PrecisionWheel]Source code[/url]
